question: Can R66 block summaries be reused after draw-order changes when unordered source membership and all other declared conditions stay fixed?
progress: R72 held the 1,941-record multiset, camera, covariance, effective-alpha calibration, Half target and block size 128 fixed while executing six deterministic reorderings. All changed orders collided under an unordered-multiset hash but changed the exact ordered key and summary digest. Recomputed summaries underestimated zero channels; stale baseline reuse underestimated 13 alpha-descending channels, with worst shortfall 0.0195359774. Exact draw order is therefore a demonstrated invalidation dimension.
nextGate: Change one locked camera parameter with source order fixed. Require effective-alpha-map and summary key invalidation, a stale-view mismatch or underbound, and zero underestimation after sequential recomputation.
